content_of_post_to_comment:
If you feel you are impatient enough to read this post, get up go wash your face and get back to this post, sit with a coffee ground yourself, set a timer and read it.

To get disciplined, the idea has been popped up inside your brain by two incidents

You are a witness of your peers success, you find yourself not putting effort.

2.You are surrounded with advice about productivity and other things on the internet.

You will never go ahead with your life, when you set goals. Yes you heard me right!

Let me talk about some philosophy.

These goals, achievements and other ambitions were man made! We as human beings set this, goal to buy a house! Earning money, clearing an exam! Everything was created by us to engage in a society.

Now if you catch yourself being highly aware you would notice you would have been into sexual f

Gratification, eating too much, one kind of important sign we miss we advise others on how to live, how to make the steps as a person who has wanted to be in that position.

When you get extremely avoident of the situation, you crave constant stimulation. There are these multimillion dollar companies invested into pushing this vulnerability of yours to make time.

Youtube, instagram, only fans, chatbots.

And if you have been engaged into any and feel guilty just remeber YOU ARE ALREADY ENOUGH.

The productivity illusion.

Who are you when no one is seeing you? Honestly! Don't feel guilty about wasting time or justify your self if you had wasted time.

I am not here to tell you to get back to life achive that dream job. My goal is to tell you would be living in this earth for the last time, embrace the life!

You could see people posting their routine, or before and after pics.

They have used social media as a tool or a thing to validate them self to dicipline.

When you can do it without that validation part involved you will start to enjoy more and live more!

Your emotions are the major factor that influence your desicion.

Don't complex your life, with fancy todo list, journal and stuffs....live a simple life, dress simple, go for a walk without your phone, gift your self a app blocker, get into real world build a hobby, connect with humans and nature....

Let you be happy and live more ....

You are already enough!

-(lovingly a fellow mate who learnt to live a little).
comment: The part about using productivity as another form of validation is something I’ve noticed too. Sometimes chasing the perfect routine becomes a safer distraction than actually doing the uncomfortable work. At the same time, goals themselves aren’t the enemy; they can be meaningful when they come from your own values rather than comparison. The tricky part is knowing which one is driving you.
